proof_checks: Linear-first inner product: beta(f)=<f,nu>; beta(f)=1 implies <epsilon,f>=1/rho; limiting phase c forced real >=1.
Global positive-root monotonicity is used, not a root/compression interchange.
d_U=2U+O(1), alpha_U=-sqrt(U/d_U) gamma_U -> beta; exact sharp coefficient one.
Normals are original graph Riesz normals; not whitened r_X=B_X^{-1/2}nu_X.
D cap ker beta dense by fixed smooth jet correction.
Whole real-parameter limit follows from arbitrary contradiction sequences; no continuity across jumps assumed.
No extension of root convergence from dense core to all H is claimed.
Only W_U of norm one is applied to moving small anchor errors.
